title: Issues ranked by the evidence behind them
description: How strong the public evidence is for each issue — not a measure of what voters say they care about.
notes: Ranks evidence strength: source tier, whether the indicator is quantified, and whether it is county-wide or localised.
This is NOT measured salience. It ranks the strength of the official record for each issue, not what voters say they care about.

values.label: Water and drought
values.note: 21% with at least basic drinking-water service — the lowest of any county in Kenya

values.label: County finance and accountability
values.note: KSh 13.79bn FY2026/27 resource envelope; own-source revenue raised from 1.12bn to 1.339bn by the Assembly

values.label: Farming and food security
values.note: NDMA drought phase Alert from Dec 2025 through Feb 2026; Normal but worsening by Aug 2026

values.label: Household economics and poverty
values.note: 55.2% of residents in poverty, about 637,000 people

values.label: How county money is split between wards
values.note: CLIDP splits county resources equally across all 40 wards; the leading rival attacks it as entrenching inequality

values.label: Youth, jobs and registration
values.note: IEBC flagged youth registration as lagging and planned a digital pre-registration route

values.label: Mui Basin coal
values.note: ~400 million tonnes of deposits; residents petitioned against mining in 2023; revival announced Oct 2025

values.label: Record and delivery
values.note: NG-CDF project record and Budget & Appropriations service
